hero.bio: I've been building for the web for 4+ years. I like getting my hands on every layer, from the UI to APIs to the database. The best part is still turning an idea into something that actually works.

madde22.desc: RESTful APIs with NestJS & Django on PostgreSQL & Redis; search with Elasticsearch & Meilisearch.

yuix.desc: SSR websites with Django & Next.js; React UIs styled with TailwindCSS.
